title: Set up the TV display
summary: Theme, which rooms to show, how often it refreshes, promotional videos, where the video column goes and music.

steps.title: Menu → TV Display
steps.details: The waiting room screen: shows who's being called in each room, promotional videos and music.

steps.title: Theme
steps.details: Dark, light or with the clinic's colors.

steps.title: Rooms
steps.details: Check which rooms show on the screen.

steps.title: Refresh
steps.details: Every how many seconds the appointments refresh.

steps.title: Promo interval
steps.details: How often the promo is shown.

steps.title: Promotional videos
steps.details: Paste video links that play on the screen.

steps.title: Video column
steps.details: Where the video goes while appointments are shown: none, left, right, top or bottom.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: The screen picks up the changes on its next refresh.
